rules.description: Verifies that MaxDate is uniform across all generated StatVars within each input.
Verify all active StatVars meet the freshness boundary (MaxDate >= '2025' for annual 207-SV input; MaxDate >= '2023' for historical 66-SV input).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: ((StatVar LIKE '%Urban%' OR StatVar LIKE '%Rural%' OR total_svs > 100) AND MaxDate >= '2025') OR (total_svs = 66 AND MaxDate >= '2023')

rules.description: Checks that deleted records do not exceed 0.1%.
